title: Kinesis project (.knsproj) — project.json, format version 10
description: See docs/knsproj.md. Coordinates are pixels with the origin at the composition centre (+x right, +y down, +z away from the viewer). Keyframe times are seconds relative to the owning layer's start. Layers are listed bottom to top.

layers.description: Top-level layers in painter's order (first = bottom).

vec2.description: [x, y] in pixels; origin at the composition centre, +y down.

vec3.description: [x, y, z] in pixels; +y down, +z away from the viewer.

easing.description: Easing of the segment that starts at this keyframe.

cubicBezier.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] like CSS cubic-bezier(); x1 and x2 within 0..1.

cyclic.description: Wave between the two keyframe values: 0.5 − 0.5·cos(2π·g), where g is the progress of the current cycle skewed by offset. With a half-integer number of cycles (1.5, 2.5, 3.5...) it starts at 0 and ends at 1.

offset.description: Skew of each cycle (default 0). Negative: the wave rises fast and falls slowly; 0: symmetric; positive: it rises slowly and falls fast. The crest sits at 0.5 + 0.45·offset of the cycle; minimum, maximum and number of cycles do not change.

phase.description: Shifts the whole wave to the right by this fraction of the segment (default 0). Kept from format v5/v6, where this was called offset.

animFloat.description: A number, or {"keyframes": [...]} to animate it, with an optional "expression".

time.description: Seconds from the start of the layer that owns the property.

loop.description: Repeat the keyframed range after the last keyframe.

expression.description: JavaScript (After Effects style). The result is the last evaluated statement; `value` is the property's own value. See docs/knsproj.md, expressions.

expressionEnabled.description: false switches the expression off without deleting it (default true).

animVec2.description: [x, y], or {"keyframes": [...]} to animate it, with an optional "expression".

time.description: Seconds from the start of the layer that owns the property.

loop.description: Repeat the keyframed range after the last keyframe.

expression.description: JavaScript (After Effects style). The result is the last evaluated statement; `value` is the property's own value. See docs/knsproj.md, expressions.

expressionEnabled.description: false switches the expression off without deleting it (default true).

animVec3.description: [x, y, z], or {"keyframes": [...]} to animate it, with an optional "expression".

time.description: Seconds from the start of the layer that owns the property.

loop.description: Repeat the keyframed range after the last keyframe.

expression.description: JavaScript (After Effects style). The result is the last evaluated statement; `value` is the property's own value. See docs/knsproj.md, expressions.

expressionEnabled.description: false switches the expression off without deleting it (default true).

animColor.description: A colour, or {"keyframes": [...]} to animate it, with an optional "expression".

time.description: Seconds from the start of the layer that owns the property.

loop.description: Repeat the keyframed range after the last keyframe.

expression.description: JavaScript (After Effects style). The result is the last evaluated statement; `value` is the property's own value. See docs/knsproj.md, expressions.

expressionEnabled.description: false switches the expression off without deleting it (default true).

path.description: Relative path inside the container, under assets/.

transform2d.description: 2D transform: position of the anchor in the parent space; scale 1 = 100%; rotation in degrees clockwise; opacity 0..1.

transform3d.description: 3D transform: rotation in degrees applied X, then Y, then Z.

effect.description: An effect of EffectRegistry; see the effects table in docs/knsproj.md.

oneOf.description: Gradient Map (Color & light). Maps each pixel's luminance to the gradient stops.
Exposure (Color & light). Exposure in EV stops, offset and gamma.
Brightness & Contrast (Color & light). Adds brightness and scales contrast around mid grey.
Saturation (Color & light). Raises or lowers saturation (-100% = greyscale).
Hue Shift (Color & light). Rotates the hue of the colours.
Invert Colors (Color & light). Inverts the colours, keeping alpha.
Fill (Color & light). Paints the layer with a solid colour, keeping alpha.
Deep Glow (Color & light). Multi-pass bloom built from the areas above the threshold.
Lens Flare (Color & light). Procedural lens flare: core, streaks and rings along the optical axis.
Tint (Color & light). Colourizes the layer keeping its luminance.
Glow (Color & light). Blurred halo around the content.
Color Balance (Color & light). Shifts the colour of shadows, midtones and highlights (mid grey = no change).
Vibrance (Color & light). Saturates muted colours more than saturated ones.
Gaussian Blur (Blur & sharpen). Gaussian blur.
Sharpen (Blur & sharpen). Unsharp mask.
Lens Blur (Blur & sharpen). Bokeh blur with a bladed aperture and bright highlights.
Directional Blur (Blur & sharpen). Blur along one direction.
Radial Blur (Blur & sharpen). Spin (degrees) or zoom (% of the distance to the centre) blur.
Pinch/Bulge (Distort). Distortion < 0 pulls towards the centre (pinch), > 0 bulges outwards, 0 does nothing.
Glass (Distort). Turns the layer into glass: refracts what is behind it (shape from alpha), with a bright rim and 7-band spectral dispersion.
Warp (Distort). Wave or fractal displacement.
Mirror (Distort). Mirrors the layer across an axis through the centre.
Twirl (Distort). Rotates the content more near the centre.
Ripple (Distort). Concentric waves from the centre.
Auto-Shake (Move & transform). Smooth pseudo-random shake of position and rotation.
Spin (Move & transform). Continuous rotation in degrees per second.
Oscillate (Move & transform). Sinusoidal wiggle of position, scale and rotation.
Float (Move & transform). Bobs up and down gently with a slight sway.
Pulse (Move & transform). Rhythmic scale pulse.
Pixelate (Stylize). Mosaic of square cells.
Drop Shadow (Stylize). Blurred cast shadow (90° = down).
Vignette (Stylize). Darkens the edges of the frame.
Halftone (Stylize). Halftone dots sized by luminance.
Posterize (Stylize). Reduces the number of levels per channel.
Film Grain (Stylize). Film grain that changes every frame.
Scanlines/CRT (Stylize). Scanlines and CRT tube curvature.
8-bit (Stylize). Pixelates on a grid and reduces the colours: levels per channel, greyscale or a fixed 16-colour console palette.
PixDither (Stylize). Ordered dithering with a Bayer matrix: few colour levels with a grid texture, in colour or in two colours.
Pixel Encoder (Stylize). Splits the picture into cells and draws in each one a character picked by its luminance (ASCII art).
Kernel (Stylize). 3×3 convolution: sharpen, emboss, edge detection, outline or the 9 weights you choose.
Block Glitch (Glitch). Displaced, channel-swapped blocks, re-rolled at each step.
Line Glitch (Glitch). Displaced horizontal slices.
VHS Tape (Glitch). VHS tracking, jitter, colour bleed, noise and scanlines.
Chromatic Aberration (Glitch). Splits the RGB channels along an angle.
RGB Split (Glitch). RGB split that jumps to random offsets (rate 0 = static).
Static Noise (Glitch). TV static over the layer.
Signal Analog (Glitch). Noise-shifted lines, RGB split, scanlines and static of a bad analog video signal.
Glitchify (Glitch). Random displaced blocks, RGB split per block and blocks that drop out (turn transparent); speed 0 freezes the glitch.
Find Edges (Drawing & edges). Highlights edges (Sobel).
Outline (Drawing & edges). Outline built from alpha.
Emboss (Drawing & edges). Relief lit from an angle.
Sketch (Drawing & edges). Pencil strokes from the edges.
Fractal Noise (Procedural). Fractal noise between two colours.
Gradient Ramp (Procedural). Linear or radial gradient between two points.
Checkerboard (Procedural). Checkerboard pattern.
Grid (Procedural). Grid lines (transparent background).
Chroma Key (Matte, mask & key). Keys out a colour (green/blue screen) with softness, spill removal and choke.
Luma Key (Matte, mask & key). Keys out dark areas (or bright ones when inverted).
Spill Suppressor (Matte, mask & key). Removes the screen colour reflected on the edges.
Matte Choker (Matte, mask & key). Shrinks (> 0) or grows (< 0) the alpha and softens the edge.
Echo (Time & transition). Copies of the layer at earlier times, fading out.
Posterize Time (Time & transition). Animates the layer at a lower frame rate (stop-motion look).
Strobe (Time & transition). Blinks the layer (hide) or flashes a colour in rhythm.
TimeSlice (Time & transition). Each strip of the picture shows a different moment of the video (time displacement).
Depth Map (Utility & expression). Shows the distance to the camera (z-buffer) of 3D layers, from white (near) to black (far).
Channel Shuffle (Utility & expression). Picks the source of each output channel.
Set Alpha from Luma (Utility & expression). Uses luminance as transparency.

mask.description: Shape mask in layer-local pixels (max 4 per layer).

matte.description: Track matte: the layer is visible where the sibling layer 'layer' is opaque/bright. The matte source is hidden automatically.

distance.description: Slide distance in px (default: 25% of the composition).

family.description: System family: sans-serif, serif, monospace, sans-serif-condensed, cursive, casual...

amount.description: px for slides/wave, degrees for rotate, starting scale % for scale.

maxWidth.description: Wrap width in px; 0 = no wrapping.

alphaPacked.description: Video frames hold colour on the left half and alpha (grey) on the right half.

eq.description: Parametric equalizer applied after the volume of the clip; omitted or empty = off.

shading.description: pbr (default): smooth physically based; flat: one normal per face (low poly); toon: hard light bands; wireframe: mesh edges only.

rotation.description: Degrees applied X, then Y, then Z; used when aim is "rotation". With zero rotation the camera looks along +z (+x right, +y down). Independent from position.

aim.description: "target" (default): look at `target`. "rotation": look along the camera's own axes turned by `rotation`; `target` is ignored.

castShadows.description: Directional and point lights: 3D objects cast shadows on 3D objects.

shadowSoftness.description: Shadow edge softness in shadow-map texels (default 1.5).

start.description: Seconds, in the time of the container (composition or group).

parent.description: Id of a sibling layer whose transform is inherited.

textPropertyAnimator.description: After Effects style text animator: properties weighted per character by the Expression Selector `amount`.

nullContent.description: Content of a null layer. A null layer draws nothing; other layers of the same dimension can use it as parent. 2D nulls use `transform`, 3D nulls (`threeD`: true) use `transform3d`.

threeD.description: true for a 3D null object (default false).

text3d.description: Extruded text of object3d layers with primitive "text". Pixels; centred on the layer origin, front face towards the default camera.

depth.description: Thickness of the extrusion in pixels (default 60).

bevel.description: Rounded edge width in pixels, at most half the depth (default 4).

depthOfField.description: Depth of field of the camera: 3D layers away from focusDistance are blurred.

environment.description: Reflections and ambient light of 3D layers. Without asset a procedural studio is used.

asset.description: Id of an image asset with an equirectangular (2:1) panorama.

marker.description: A named point in time on the timeline ruler, independent of the layers.

eqBand.description: One band of the parametric equalizer.

editorView.description: The free camera of the editor viewport and which view it shows. Editor state: never rendered into the video.

mode.description: camera = the active camera's picture (default); editor = the free camera; inside = through the active camera, gestures move it.

target.description: Point the editor camera looks at (composition pixels).

pitch.description: Degrees; positive looks down from above.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees.

rotoStroke.description: A brush stroke of the Roto Brush.

mode.description: add = part of the object (default); remove = not part of it.

size.description: Brush diameter as a fraction of the frame's shorter side (default 0.06).

points.description: Points [x, y] of the stroke, normalised 0..1 in the upright frame.

rotoFrame.description: The strokes painted on one frame.

rotoBrush.description: How a packed-alpha video was cut out with the Roto Brush: the source video and the strokes, so it can be edited again.

source.description: Asset id of the source video.

sourceStart.description: Seconds into the source where the cut-out starts (default 0).

duration.description: Seconds of the source that the cut-out covers.
